results.title: Scientist Home Future Health Trial Demonstrates Significant Reduction in Eczema Symptoms using Evidence-based Nutritional Therapy
results.description: HONG KONG, Sept. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Scientist Home Future Health LTD (OTCID: SHFH ) (Scientist home or ‘The Company’) is pleased to announce Researchers at Scientist Home have announced promising results from a landmark clinical trial, showing a significant reduction in the severity and duration of symptoms for patients suffering from Severe Eczema. The findings in the significant reduction of symptoms mark a potential turning point in the management of this challenging condition.
